cohorts.role: Independent repository relative to the known lru-cache development control. Previously observed task; this fresh batch is not a new holdout and is not pooled with the stopped run. Freshly declared after a pure-trust path-alias false stop, without pooling either stopped batch.

environment.nativeGuard: Native session pins matrix-listed user configuration/Skills, both evaluated Skills, bench and compiled runner before/after each invocation. Inherited configuration is not isolated.
environment.rtkCheck: Additional referenced instruction checked before and after the whole batch; native matrix configurations checked around each call.
environment.workspaceAliases: Native plan freezes logical and physical paths before calls; only pure trust entries for those names are excluded. Retargeting or any other config change stops calls.

calibration.reason: No new calibration; same pinned task, grader and both Skill resources. Timing repair is tested offline before declaring four calls.

analysis: Analyze all declared surviving pairs in this new batch separately. Enumerate improved/regressed public checks and pass/fail. Report paired and all-invocation input/cache/uncached/output/monotonic elapsed, coverage, increases and per-success costs including graded failures. Retain errors and refusal receipts. Never pool old wall durations with new monotonic durations or claim billing/active compute. Readiness counts/usage are additional study spending and remain separate from all comparative populations. Older stopped cohorts remain separate; no retrospective grading or pooling.
stopping: Any execution error, timing anomaly or input/configuration drift stops further calls. No retries, replacement samples, candidate edits or trial additions. Functional failures remain data. Preserve this batch even if incomplete. Power assertions are verified at startup; utility liveness is recorded at finish, not independently attested before every call. A small saturated two-pair task cannot support efficacy, equivalence, non-inferiority or an installation recommendation. One readiness check is allowed after a ten-minute connection cooldown. It must return READY before any of the four native benchmark calls. Do not retry either phase within this batch or change model/effort/tier/timeout in response to results.
reproducibility: Frozen compiled runner/source, complete Skill/bench inputs, declaration, native receipts/call ledger/public transcripts, timing diagnostics, power assertion record, all deliveries and archive file hashes. Fresh extraction must regrade and reproduce cost analysis; fresh live runs reproduce procedure, not identical stochastic outputs.

interruptedRecovery.status: stopped after one original-Skill invocation; no graded pairs; do not reclassify or replace it

availability.prompt: Respond with the single word READY. Do not use tools or modify files.
availability.purpose: Readiness only, never a graded task, calibration or judge; separately retain spending. A failed readiness check makes no benchmark calls and is never repeated within this batch.
